title: Register admin router in chatbot/api/app.py
description:
Modify chatbot/api/app.py to register the admin_router from chatbot/api/admin.py on the FastAPI application instance. Follow the existing router registration pattern.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- chatbot/api/app.py (existing FastAPI app with other router registrations — understand import pattern, FastAPI instance variable name, and include_router convention)
- chatbot/api/admin.py (created by task t.6 — understand the router variable name: admin_router)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/api/app.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

SINGLE-OWNER FILE: chatbot/api/app.py is owned exclusively by this task in this phase. No other task may modify it.

Implementation details:

1. Open chatbot/api/app.py and locate the existing `app.include_router(...)` calls. Understand the pattern: the variable name used for the FastAPI instance, how routers are imported, and the include_router call signature.

2. Import admin_router from chatbot.api.admin.

3. Add a new `app.include_router(admin_router)` call following the existing convention. Do not change how other routers are registered.

4. Do NOT create a new FastAPI instance, change the app variable name, add CORS middleware, or apply auth dependencies to the admin router. The admin router intentionally has no auth (operator tooling).

5. Ensure python -m py_compile chatbot/api/app.py passes.
acceptance_criteria: Existing router registrations in app.py are unchanged
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add CORS, middleware, auth, or any new configuration to the admin router
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: add an import statement for admin_router
follow existing import and registration conventions
forbidden: add any new features or endpoints directly in app.py
apply auth dependency to the admin router
